page_title: LEN 1-2 PSG | Lens v PSG 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+3' Senny Mayulu (PSG) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Senny Mayulu (PSG) has tested the patience of referee Jeremie Pignard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90' What a wasted opportunity by Senny Mayulu (PSG)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the left side of the goal, but Herve Koffi makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
88' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Desire Doue and he is replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
87' Substitution. Angelo Fulgini (Lens) replaces Facundo Medina.
86' 1 - 2 Joao Neves plays a neat ball into the path of Bradley Barcola (PSG), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the crossbar! 1:2.
81' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Gianluigi Donnarumma easily deals with the threat.
81' Herve Koffi (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
80' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Adrien Thomasson will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
80' Substitution. Florian Sotoca leaves the pitch and is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
79' Looks like Herve Koffi (Lens) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
78' Desire Doue (PSG) gets inside the box and tries to beat Herve Koffi with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
76' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
73' The total number of attempts is 8:4.
71' The linesman signals that M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
70' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
69' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
69' Deiver Machado (Lens) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
67' Here is a change. Goduine Koyalipou is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
67' Andy Diouf will be replaced by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens).
66' The corner from Andy Diouf (Lens) is intercepted by the defence.

66' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
65' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
61' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Adrien Thomasson (Lens) for his blatant foul.
60' It is time for a substitution. Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is on for Kang-In Lee.
60' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joao Neves (PSG) replacing Lucas Hernandez.

59' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Bradley Barcola, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Fabian Ruiz (PSG), who beats Herve Koffi with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
58' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as M'Bala Nzola (Lens) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
56' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
54' Bradley Barcola (PSG) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Herve Koffi anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

49' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Deiver Machado (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
44' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Adrien Thomasson (Lens) inside the box.
43' Nuno Mendes (PSG) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
42' Nuno Mendes (PSG) picks up an injury.
41' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is caught offside!
40' Deiver Machado (Lens) is penalised for holding. Jeremie Pignard signals a set piece.
36' 1 - 0 M'Bala Nzola (Lens) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the bottom right corner.
36' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
36' The ball is cleared after Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Lens earn a corner.
35' Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul after Facundo Medina (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
34' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Lens win a corner.
32' The percentage of ball possession is – 33:67.
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vitinha (PSG) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' The game is interrupted. Malang Sarr (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
25' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
24' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared.
24' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Desire Doue (PSG) gets inside the box and tries to beat Herve Koffi with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
21' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Facundo Medina (Lens) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
15' Facundo Medina (Lens) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
14' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
13' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremie Pignard no option but to blow his whistle.
7' Desire Doue (PSG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Herve Koffi, who smothers the ball.
4' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
PSG will kick the game off.
Jeremie Pignard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
